name: October
objective: Gift-led acquisition and Diwali renewals without codes; upgrade 1 Month members to 3 Months before the November dip.
strategy:
Festival of Lights.

Commercial job: Gift-led acquisition and Diwali renewals without codes; upgrade 1 Month members to 3 Months before the November dip.

Newcomer: Gift a Flight (“Give someone three classes and a reason to stay.”). Gifting is real Diwali spend, and a Flight leads into the best-converting journey.

Winback: Come Home for Diwali (“Your mat's still here, at 20% off.”). Simple, on-theme, and the pack fits festive schedules.

Renewal: Pay It Forward (“Renew in October; get 10% back to gift a friend.”). Turns renewal value into new-client acquisition: the discount only exists if it brings someone new.

Renewal: Light Years Ahead (“Upgrade for Diwali: 3 months at 20% off.”). Upgrading before November protects the base through the softest month of the year and lifts cash 2.3×.
notes:
Moment: Gift cards on sale from 1 Oct; candle-lit evening classes in Diwali week (25–28 Oct); a 'Lights On' community class on Sat 23 Oct.
Build: new clients 42 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹5.0L; reactivation 36 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.1L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.5L; renewals ₹26.8L. First visits needed 140 vs 102 last year (1.37×); CRM leads needed 280 vs 67 last year.

items.detail: Set up Gift a Flight in Momence (1 Oct–15 Nov.): A Tasting Flight gift card for ₹2,499 (3 classes in 10 days, 3 different formats) — the recipient's ₹2,499 is credited and they get 1 Month at 20% off (₹16,191) if they buy within 72 hours of class 3; the giver gets 1 bonus class when they do.
Set up Come Home for Diwali in Momence (All October.): A 12-class pack at 20% off (₹15,750) — a comeback class in Diwali week.
Set up Pay It Forward in Momence (All October.): Your current membership at list — 10% of what you pay back as credit, usable only on a P57 gift card for someone new.
Set up Light Years Ahead in Momence (All October.): From 1 Month to 3 Months at 20% off (₹46,284), 6 Months at 22% off (₹88,698) — a festive box and the candle-lit Diwali week classes on us.
Brief the team on the 4 October offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Gift a Flight to Anyone buying for a friend new to P57.
Launch Come Home for Diwali to Lapsed clients.
Launch Pay It Forward to October renewers.
Launch Light Years Ahead to 1 Month members.
Run paid lead ads for Gift a Flight: 280 CRM leads needed vs 67 in the same month last year.
Run the month's moment: Gift cards on sale from 1 Oct; candle-lit evening classes in Diwali week (25–28 Oct); a 'Lights On' community class on Sat 23 Oct.

Weekly check: Gift a Flight: Gift cards sold; activations; recipient conversion. | Come Home for Diwali: Reactivations. | Pay It Forward: Credit used on gift cards. | Light Years Ahead: 1M → 3M upgrades.
Mid-month review against ₹39.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 208 renewals, 36 reactivations and 42 new buyers (140 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close October: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief November's offers.
